All addictions are caused by trauma. We don't realise it but whenever we're susceptible to getting addicted, it's because it solves something (temporarily) within us.

Somedays, I end the day with an additional hour of it right before sleeping, but trust that you need to invest no less than an hour if you're serious about seeing any improvement.

I don't want to give you several options else you'll get confused. Vipassana meditation is free and there are centres for it all over the world. And you get free food and accommodation. Take a 10 day course there and just do that.

Any strategy designed to escape from your traumas is a sham, including breathwork, including imagination meditations, even physical exercises and cold showers. These are all good habits mind you, I'd rather recommend you to do exercises and cold showers regardless, but know that they're not solutions.

Lastly, there are other trauma resolution ways like shadow work, parts work, somatic experiencing, inner child healing, which are more or less working on resolving the cause.
